description: Dialogue acts of the HEDGE ExpertAI Store assistant, with English example utterances. APP stands for any App mention (name, native ID or provider reference), so the examples hold for future Apps. Source of the Rasa NLU corpus (scripts/generate_rasa_nlu.py) and of the semantic nearest-example classifier.

thanks.gloss: thanks the assistant or says goodbye

help.gloss: asks what the assistant can do
examples: what kind of questions can I ask?
I'm not sure where to start
how do I use this chat?
explain what you can help with

reset.gloss: wants to start the conversation over

out_of_scope.gloss: asks about something unrelated to the App Store
examples: can you book me a flight
what is the stock price of Tesla
who is the president of France?
how tall is the Eiffel tower
what's the score of the match?
tell me about the history of Rome
is it going to snow this weekend

list.gloss: wants to see which Apps the Store has
examples: what is in the app store?
give me an overview of the apps
what do you have in the catalogue?
how many apps do you have?
how many applications are in the store
what apps can I choose from
list the apps and what they do
what kind of apps are there?
tell me what apps exist and their purpose
anything in the store I could look at?
show all the tools you have
give me the list of applications

describe.gloss: wants to know what an App is or does
examples: can you tell me about APP
I'd like to know about APP
what does the second app do?
what is the purpose of APP
what is the app called APP

simple.gloss: wants a simpler explanation of an App
examples: what does it do, in simple words
I'm not technical, what does it mean in practice
for a non-expert, what is it

example.gloss: wants an example of an App in use
examples: what would that look like in practice?
show me a concrete use case
how would someone actually use it, for example?
an example of APP in use

analogy.gloss: wants an analogy for an App
examples: what's a good analogy for APP

how.gloss: wants to know how an App works
examples: walk me through how it works
how would it work in practice
step by step, how does it work

differently.gloss: wants the explanation said another way
examples: can you put it another way?
that didn't help, explain it some other way
explain it from a different angle

meaning.gloss: did not understand the last explanation
examples: what does that mean in practice?

audience.gloss: wants to know who an App is for
examples: is it meant for companies or households?
what type of organisation uses this
is it for end users or operators?

provider.gloss: wants to know who provides an App

price.gloss: wants to know what an App costs
examples: do I have to pay for it?
what does it cost to use

access.gloss: wants to know how to access, install or use an App, or where its documentation is
examples: how can I start using it?
how do I get started with it
do I need to install something
how do I connect to it
is there a website for APP

details.gloss: wants an App's technical metadata, such as versions or connector
examples: what type of app is it

check.gloss: wants to know whether a particular App can do something
examples: is APP able to handle bids?
can I use it for monitoring temperature?
is it capable of validating schemas?
does APP have a mobile app?
does it cover demand forecasting too?
could I use APP to map vocabularies?
does this app track energy usage?
is it possible to export reports with APP?
is APP able to combine bids?
does APP send data to the cloud?
does that one do bid submission?
does it do anything with weather data?

find.gloss: wants an App that does something
examples: I need an app for flexibility trading
is there anything for meter data?
find me an app that forecasts demand
recommend something for wind farm maintenance
we want to aggregate offers from aggregators
looking for a tool to manage data models
what should I use for solar forecasting?
our grid has congestion problems, what can help?
is there an app that converts payloads?
I want to monitor building temperatures
what can I use to share vocabularies
we're a utility and need demand response, what's available?
something for tracking data sharing consent?
which one helps with heat planning
we have too many sensors sending messages, is there a tool to forward them?
any tool that predicts electricity prices
which app would help a DSO buy flexibility?
is there an app that does?
are there any that do that?
I'd like an app to plan maintenance
what would you recommend for audits of old bids?
do you have anything for data quality?
need something to visualise energy use
what's the difference between APP and APP?
how is APP different from APP
what do APP and APP have in common?
how does it compare to APP?
difference between the first and second one

choose.gloss: wants to know which of several Apps suits a need
examples: which one is better for settlement?
which of them should I use?
which would you pick for forecasting?
APP or APP for data mapping?
which suits a small utility better
which of the two is right for me
which is the better fit for monitoring
which one would you recommend for my case?
which one would help me plan maintenance?
which of them would help with data exchange?
which app would suit settlement better?
which one is meant for forecasting?
which of these is good for monitoring?
which of the two would help an operator?

term.gloss: wants a word or concept explained
examples: what does baseline mean in this context?
what is a virtual power plant

ask.gloss: asks a specific question about an App's details
examples: how does APP calculate the payments?
what happens if a bid fails?
how many users can it handle?
does it need internet access to run?
where does the data come from?
what does it do with my data?
how far ahead can it look?
what does it require to run?
is it only for large companies?

same.gloss: asks the previous question again, about another App
examples: sorry, I meant the other one

remove_constraint.gloss: wants to drop an earlier condition
